findings.title: Local File Inclusion (LFI) leading to Flag Disclosure
findings.description: The post.php endpoint is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion (LFI) via the 'id' parameter. An attacker can traverse the filesystem using directory traversal sequences (../../../../../) to read arbitrary files such as /etc/passwd and Apache access logs. The flag was discovered by injecting PHP code into the User-Agent header and then including the Apache access log to execute the injected code.

reproduction.expected: Flag output from executed PHP code
